summary: Hancock Whitney Corp filed an 8-K announcing it received regulatory approvals from the Federal Reserve, FDIC, and Mississippi Department of Banking for its acquisition of OFB Bancshares, parent of One Florida Bank. Shareholders of OFB Bancshares approved the merger agreement at a special meeting. The deal, initially announced on May 15, 2026, is expected to close on or about August 1, 2026, subject to other customary conditions. No financial terms, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The filing confirms regulatory clearance and shareholder approval, moving the transaction toward closing. Watch for the closing date and any last-minute regulatory or shareholder issues.
